InputRichBlockAnchor.name: InputRichBlockAnchor

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “anchor”

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the anchor

InputRichBlockAnchor.description: A block with an anchor, corresponding to the HTML tag <a> with the attribute name.

InputRichBlockAnimation.name: InputRichBlockAnimation

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “animation”

fields.name: animation
fields.description: The animation. Caption is ignored.

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption of the block

InputRichBlockAnimation.description: A block with an animation, corresponding to the HTML tag <video>.

InputRichBlockAudio.name: InputRichBlockAudio

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “audio”

fields.name: audio
fields.description: The audio. Caption is ignored.

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption of the block

InputRichBlockAudio.description: A block with a music file, corresponding to the HTML tag <audio>.

InputRichBlockBlockQuotation.name: InputRichBlockBlockQuotation

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “blockquote”

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: Content of the block

fields.name: credit
fields.description: Credit of the block

InputRichBlockBlockQuotation.description: A block quotation, corresponding to the HTML tag <blockquote>.

InputRichBlockButtons.name: InputRichBlockButtons

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “buttons”

fields.name: buttons
fields.description: List of 1-8 buttons to send

fields.name: align
fields.description: Horizontal alignment of the buttons. Currently, must be one of “left”, “center”, or “right”.

InputRichBlockButtons.description: A block containing a list of buttons that are shown in one row, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-button-row>.

InputRichBlockCollage.name: InputRichBlockCollage

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “collage”

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: Elements of the collage

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption of the block

InputRichBlockCollage.description: A collage, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-collage>.

InputRichBlockDetails.name: InputRichBlockDetails

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “details”

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Always shown summary of the block

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: Content of the block

fields.name: is_open
fields.description: Pass True if the content of the block is visible by default

InputRichBlockDetails.description: An expandable block for details disclosure, corresponding to the HTML tag <details>.

InputRichBlockDivider.name: InputRichBlockDivider

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “divider”

InputRichBlockDivider.description: A divider, corresponding to the HTML tag <hr/>.

InputRichBlockDocument.name: InputRichBlockDocument

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “document”

fields.name: document
fields.description: The document. Caption is ignored.

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption of the block

InputRichBlockDocument.description: A block with a general file, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-document>.

InputRichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation.name: InputRichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “expandable_blockquote”

fields.name: text
fields.description: Content of the block

fields.name: credit
fields.description: Credit of the block

InputRichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation.description: A block quotation, corresponding to the HTML tag <blockquote> with custom attribute "expandable".

InputRichBlockFooter.name: InputRichBlockFooter

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “footer”

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text of the block

InputRichBlockFooter.description: A footer, corresponding to the HTML tag <footer>.

InputRichBlockList.name: InputRichBlockList

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “list”

fields.name: items
fields.description: Items of the list

InputRichBlockList.description: A list of blocks, corresponding to the HTML tag <ul> or <ol> with multiple nested tags <li>.

InputRichBlockListItem.name: InputRichBlockListItem

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: The content of the item

fields.name: has_checkbox
fields.description: Pass True if the item has a checkbox

fields.name: is_checked
fields.description: Pass True if the item has a checked checkbox

fields.name: value
fields.description: For ordered lists, the numeric value of the item label

fields.name: type
fields.description: For ordered lists, the type of the item label; must be one of “a” for lowercase letters, “A” for uppercase letters, “i” for lowercase Roman numerals, “I” for uppercase Roman numerals, or “1” for decimal numbers

InputRichBlockListItem.description: An item of a list to be sent.

InputRichBlockMap.name: InputRichBlockMap

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “map”

fields.name: location
fields.description: Location of the center of the map

fields.name: zoom
fields.description: Map zoom level; 0-24

fields.name: width
fields.description: Map width; 0-10000

fields.name: height
fields.description: Map height; 0-10000

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption of the block

InputRichBlockMap.description: A block with a map, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-map>. The map's width and height must not exceed 10000 in total. The width and height ratio must be at most 20.

InputRichBlockMathematicalExpression.name: InputRichBlockMathematicalExpression

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “mathematical_expression”

fields.name: expression
fields.description: The mathematical expression in LaTeX format

InputRichBlockMathematicalExpression.description: A block with a mathematical expression in LaTeX format, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-math-block>.

InputRichBlockParagraph.name: InputRichBlockParagraph

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “paragraph”

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text of the block

InputRichBlockParagraph.description:
A text paragraph, corresponding to the HTML tag

.

InputRichBlockPhoto.name: InputRichBlockPhoto

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “photo”

fields.name: photo
fields.description: The photo. Caption is ignored.

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption of the block

InputRichBlockPhoto.description: A block with a photo, corresponding to the HTML tag .

InputRichBlockPreformatted.name: InputRichBlockPreformatted

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “pre”

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text of the block

fields.name: language
fields.description: The programming language of the text

InputRichBlockPreformatted.description: A preformatted text block, corresponding to the nested HTML tags <pre> and <code>.

InputRichBlockPullQuotation.name: InputRichBlockPullQuotation

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “pullquote”

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text of the block

fields.name: credit
fields.description: Credit of the block

InputRichBlockPullQuotation.description: A quotation with centered text, loosely corresponding to the HTML tag <aside>.

InputRichBlockSectionHeading.name: InputRichBlockSectionHeading

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “heading”

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text of the block

fields.name: size
fields.description: Relative size of the text font; 1-6, 1 is the largest, 6 is the smallest

InputRichBlockSectionHeading.description: A section heading, corresponding to the HTML tags <h1>, <h2>, <h3>, <h4>, <h5>, or <h6>.

InputRichBlockSlideshow.name: InputRichBlockSlideshow

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “slideshow”

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: Elements of the slideshow

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption of the block

InputRichBlockSlideshow.description: A slideshow, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-slideshow>.

InputRichBlockTable.name: InputRichBlockTable

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “table”

fields.name: cells
fields.description: Cells of the table

fields.name: is_bordered
fields.description: Pass True if the table has borders

fields.name: is_striped
fields.description: Pass True if the table is striped

fields.name: is_compact
fields.description: Pass True if table cells must have smaller indents

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption of the table

InputRichBlockTable.description: A table, corresponding to the HTML tag <table>.

InputRichBlockThinking.name: InputRichBlockThinking

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “thinking”

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text of the block. See https://t.me/addemoji/AIActions for examples of custom emoji that are recommended for usage in the block.

InputRichBlockThinking.description: A block with a “Thinking…” placeholder, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-thinking>. The block may be used only in sendRichMessageDraft, therefore it can't be received in messages. See https://t.me/addemoji/AIActions for examples of custom emoji that are recommended for usage in the block.

InputRichBlockVideo.name: InputRichBlockVideo

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “video”

fields.name: video
fields.description: The video. Caption is ignored.

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption of the block

InputRichBlockVideo.description: A block with a video, corresponding to the HTML tag <video>.

InputRichBlockVoiceNote.name: InputRichBlockVoiceNote

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the block, always “voice_note”

fields.name: voice_note
fields.description: The voice note. Caption is ignored.

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption of the block

InputRichBlockVoiceNote.description: A block with a voice note, corresponding to the HTML tag <audio>.

InputRichMessage.name: InputRichMessage

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: Content of the rich message to send described as a list of blocks

fields.name: html
fields.description: Content of the rich message to send described using HTML formatting. See rich message formatting options for more details. Use media field to specify the media used in the message.

fields.name: markdown
fields.description: Content of the rich message to send described using Markdown formatting. See rich message formatting options for more details. Use media field to specify the media used in the message.

fields.name: media
fields.description: List of media that are specified in the markdown or html fields using tg://photo?id=, tg://video?id=, tg://document?id=, and tg://audio?id= links

fields.name: is_rtl
fields.description: Pass True if the rich message must be shown right-to-left

fields.name: skip_entity_detection
fields.description: Pass True to skip automatic detection of entities (e.g., URLs, email addresses, username mentions, hashtags, cashtags, bot commands, or phone numbers) in the text

InputRichMessage.description: Describes a rich message to be sent. Exactly one of the fields html, markdown, or blocks must be used.

InputRichMessageContent.name: InputRichMessageContent

fields.name: rich_message
fields.description: The message to be sent. Only previously uploaded files may be used in the message.

InputRichMessageContent.description: Represents the content of a rich message to be sent as the result of an inline query.

InputRichMessageMedia.name: InputRichMessageMedia

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the media used in a tg://photo?id=, tg://video?id=, tg://document?id=, or tg://audio?id= link. 1-64 characters, only A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ and - are allowed.

fields.name: media
fields.type: InputMediaAnimation or InputMediaAudio or InputMediaDocument or InputMediaPhoto or InputMediaVideo or InputMediaVoiceNote
fields.description: The media to be sent. Everything except the media itself and its properties is ignored.

InputRichMessageMedia.description: Describes a media element embedded in an outgoing rich message.

InputSharedWidgetMessageContent.name: InputSharedWidgetMessageContent

fields.name: widget_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the shared widget created by the bot

fields.name: chat_data
fields.description: Data of the widget, which is specific to the message, 0-1024 bytes

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Widget caption, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing

fields.name: parse_mode
fields.description: Mode for parsing entities in the widget caption. See formatting options for more details.

fields.name: caption_entities
fields.description: List of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of parse_mode

fields.name: show_caption_above_media
fields.description: Pass True if the caption must be shown above the widget

InputSharedWidgetMessageContent.description: Represents the content of a message with a shared widget to be sent as the result of an inline query. Currently, widgets can't be sent in response to inline queries in the production environment.

InputSticker.name: InputSticker

fields.name: sticker
fields.description: The added sticker. Pass a file_id as a String to send a file that already exists on the Telegram servers, pass an HTTP URL as a String for Telegram to get a file from the Internet, or pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” to upload a new file using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name> name. Animated and video stickers can't be uploaded via HTTP URL. More information on Sending Files »

fields.name: format
fields.description: Format of the added sticker, must be one of “static” for a .WEBP or .PNG image, “animated” for a .TGS animation, “video” for a .WEBM video

fields.name: emoji_list
fields.description: List of 1-20 emoji associated with the sticker

fields.name: mask_position
fields.description: Position where the mask should be placed on faces. For “mask” stickers only.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: List of 0-20 search keywords for the sticker with total length of up to 64 characters. For “regular” and “custom_emoji” stickers only.

InputSticker.description: This object describes a sticker to be added to a sticker set.

InputStoryContent.name: InputStoryContent
InputStoryContent.description: This object describes the content of a story to post. Currently, it can be one of

InputStoryContentPhoto.name: InputStoryContentPhoto

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the content, must be photo

fields.name: photo
fields.description: The photo to post as a story. The photo must be of the size 1080x1920 and must not exceed 10 MB. The photo can't be reused and can only be uploaded as a new file, so you can pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” if the photo was uploaded using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name>. More information on Sending Files »

InputStoryContentPhoto.description: Describes a photo to post as a story.

InputStoryContentVideo.name: InputStoryContentVideo

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the content, must be video

fields.name: video
fields.description: The video to post as a story. The video must be of the size 720x1280, streamable, encoded with H.265 codec, with key frames added each second in the MPEG4 format, and must not exceed 30 MB. The video can't be reused and can only be uploaded as a new file, so you can pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” if the video was uploaded using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name>. More information on Sending Files »

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Precise duration of the video in seconds; 0-60

fields.name: cover_frame_timestamp
fields.description: Timestamp in seconds of the frame that will be used as the static cover for the story. Defaults to 0.0.

fields.name: is_animation
fields.description: Pass True if the video has no sound

InputStoryContentVideo.description: Describes a video to post as a story.

InputTextMessageContent.name: InputTextMessageContent

fields.name: message_text
fields.description: Text of the message to be sent, 1-4096 characters

fields.name: parse_mode
fields.description: Mode for parsing entities in the message text. See formatting options for more details.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: List of special entities that appear in message text, which can be specified instead of parse_mode

fields.name: link_preview_options
fields.description: Link preview generation options for the message

InputTextMessageContent.description: Represents the content of a text message to be sent as the result of an inline query.

InputVenueMessageContent.name: InputVenueMessageContent

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the venue in degrees

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the venue in degrees

fields.name: title
fields.description: Name of the venue

fields.name: address
fields.description: Address of the venue

fields.name: foursquare_id
fields.description: Foursquare identifier of the venue, if known

fields.name: foursquare_type
fields.description: Foursquare type of the venue, if known. (For example, “arts_entertainment/default”, “arts_entertainment/aquarium” or “food/icecream”.)

fields.name: google_place_id
fields.description: Google Places identifier of the venue

fields.name: google_place_type
fields.description: Google Places type of the venue. (See supported types.)

InputVenueMessageContent.description: Represents the content of a venue message to be sent as the result of an inline query.

InputWidgetMessageContent.name: InputWidgetMessageContent

fields.name: html
fields.description: HTML code of the widget, 1-32768 bytes. The code must not exceed 4096 bytes when compressed by zlib with the maximum compression level.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Width of the widget in logical pixels; omit if the widget must occupy the whole width of the message bubble. The width is clamped by the app to the range from 200 to the maximum width of the message bubble.

fields.name: height
fields.description: Height of the widget in logical pixels; omit if the height of the widget isn't fixed. The height is clamped by the app to the range 50-600.

fields.name: public_data
fields.description: Public data of the widget, 0-1024 bytes, which will be available wherever the widget is shown. If the widget is shared, then all messages with it will have the same public data.

fields.name: chat_data
fields.description: Data of the widget, which is specific to the message, 0-1024 bytes

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Widget caption, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing

fields.name: parse_mode
fields.description: Mode for parsing entities in the widget caption. See formatting options for more details.

fields.name: caption_entities
fields.description: List of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of parse_mode

fields.name: show_caption_above_media
fields.description: Pass True if the caption must be shown above the widget

fields.name: allow_queries
fields.description: Pass True to allow the widget to send queries to the bot

fields.name: is_shared
fields.description: Pass True to create a shared widget. Each message sent from the result creates a separate shared widget, whose identifier is received by the bot only in the field widget_id of queries from the widget. To send an existing shared widget in response to an inline query, use InputSharedWidgetMessageContent instead.

InputWidgetMessageContent.description: Represents the content of a message with an HTML widget to be sent as the result of an inline query. Currently, widgets can't be sent in response to inline queries in the production environment.

Invoice.name: Invoice

fields.name: title
fields.description: Product name

fields.name: description
fields.description: Product description

fields.name: start_parameter
fields.description: Unique bot deep-linking parameter that can be used to generate this invoice

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, or “XTR” for payments in Telegram Stars

fields.name: total_amount
fields.description: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in currencies.json, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

Invoice.description: This object contains basic information about an invoice.

KeyboardButton.name: KeyboardButton

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text of the button. If none of the fields other than text, icon_custom_emoji_id, and style are used, it will be sent as a message when the button is pressed.

fields.name: icon_custom_emoji_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the custom emoji shown before the text of the button. Can only be used by bots that purchased additional usernames on Fragment or in the messages directly sent by the bot to private, group and supergroup chats if the owner of the bot has a Telegram Premium subscription.

fields.name: style
fields.description: Style of the button. Must be one of “danger” (red), “success” (green) or “primary” (blue). If omitted, then an app-specific style is used.

fields.name: request_users
fields.description: If specified, pressing the button will open a list of suitable users. Identifiers of selected users will be sent to the bot in a “users_shared” service message. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: request_chat
fields.description: If specified, pressing the button will open a list of suitable chats. Tapping on a chat will send its identifier to the bot in a “chat_shared” service message. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: request_managed_bot
fields.description: If specified, pressing the button will ask the user to create and share a bot that will be managed by the current bot. Available for bots that enabled management of other bots in the @BotFather Mini App. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: request_contact
fields.description: If True, the user's phone number will be sent as a contact when the button is pressed. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: request_location
fields.description: If True, the user's current location will be sent when the button is pressed. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: request_poll
fields.description: If specified, the user will be asked to create a poll and send it to the bot when the button is pressed. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: web_app
fields.description: If specified, the described Web App will be launched when the button is pressed. The Web App will be able to send a “web_app_data” service message. Available in private chats only.

KeyboardButton.description: This object represents one button of the reply keyboard. At most one of the fields other than text, icon_custom_emoji_id, and style must be used to specify the type of the button. For simple text buttons, String can be used instead of this object to specify the button text.

KeyboardButtonPollType.name: KeyboardButtonPollType

fields.name: type
fields.description: If quiz is passed, the user will be allowed to create only polls in the quiz mode. If regular is passed, only regular polls will be allowed. Otherwise, the user will be allowed to create a poll of any type.

KeyboardButtonPollType.description: This object represents type of a poll, which is allowed to be created and sent when the corresponding button is pressed.

KeyboardButtonRequestChat.name: KeyboardButtonRequestChat

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Signed 32-bit identifier of the request, which will be received back in the ChatShared object. Must be unique within the message.

fields.name: chat_is_channel
fields.description: Pass True to request a channel chat, pass False to request a group or a supergroup chat

fields.name: chat_is_forum
fields.description: Pass True to request a forum supergroup, pass False to request a non-forum chat. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: chat_has_username
fields.description: Pass True to request a supergroup or a channel with a username, pass False to request a chat without a username. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: chat_is_created
fields.description: Pass True to request a chat owned by the user. Otherwise, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: user_administrator_rights
fields.description: A JSON-serialized object listing the required administrator rights of the user in the chat. The rights must be a superset of bot_administrator_rights. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: bot_administrator_rights
fields.description: A JSON-serialized object listing the required administrator rights of the bot in the chat. The rights must be a subset of user_administrator_rights. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: bot_is_member
fields.description: Pass True to request a chat with the bot as a member. Otherwise, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: request_title
fields.description: Pass True to request the chat's title

fields.name: request_username
fields.description: Pass True to request the chat's username

fields.name: request_photo
fields.description: Pass True to request the chat's photo

KeyboardButtonRequestChat.description: This object defines the criteria used to request a suitable chat. Information about the selected chat will be shared with the bot when the corresponding button is pressed. The bot will be granted requested rights in the chat if appropriate. More about requesting chats ».

KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot.name: KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Signed 32-bit identifier of the request. Must be unique within the message.

fields.name: suggested_name
fields.description: Suggested name for the bot

fields.name: suggested_username
fields.description: Suggested username for the bot. The username must end with “bot”. If the user creating the bot has a Telegram Premium subscription, then the username can also end with “agent”, “ai”, “app”, “game”, or “gay”; in this case, the username will be assigned to the bot as a secondary username, and a regular username ending with “bot” will be assigned to the bot automatically.

KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot.description: This object defines the parameters for the creation of a managed bot. Information about the created bot will be shared with the bot using the update managed_bot and a Message with the field managed_bot_created.

KeyboardButtonRequestUsers.name: KeyboardButtonRequestUsers

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Signed 32-bit identifier of the request that will be received back in the UsersShared object. Must be unique within the message.

fields.name: user_is_bot
fields.description: Pass True to request bots, pass False to request regular users. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: user_is_premium
fields.description: Pass True to request premium users, pass False to request non-premium users. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: max_quantity
fields.description: The maximum number of users to be selected; 1-10. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: request_name
fields.description: Pass True to request the users' first and last names

fields.name: request_username
fields.description: Pass True to request the users' usernames

fields.name: request_photo
fields.description: Pass True to request the users' photos

KeyboardButtonRequestUsers.description: This object defines the criteria used to request suitable users. Information about the selected users will be shared with the bot when the corresponding button is pressed. More about requesting users »

LabeledPrice.name: LabeledPrice

fields.name: label
fields.description: Portion label

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Price of the product in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of US$ 1.45 pass amount = 145. See the exp parameter in currencies.json, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

LabeledPrice.description: This object represents a portion of the price for goods or services.

fields.name: url
fields.description: URL of the link

LinkPreviewOptions.name: LinkPreviewOptions

fields.name: is_disabled
fields.description: True, if the link preview is disabled

fields.name: url
fields.description: URL to use for the link preview. If empty, then the first URL found in the message text will be used.

fields.name: prefer_small_media
fields.description: True, if the media in the link preview is supposed to be shrunk; ignored if the URL isn't explicitly specified or media size change isn't supported for the preview

fields.name: prefer_large_media
fields.description: True, if the media in the link preview is supposed to be enlarged; ignored if the URL isn't explicitly specified or media size change isn't supported for the preview

fields.name: show_above_text
fields.description: True, if the link preview must be shown above the message text; otherwise, the link preview will be shown below the message text

LinkPreviewOptions.description: Describes the options used for link preview generation.

LivePhoto.name: LivePhoto

fields.name: photo
fields.description: Available sizes of the corresponding static photo

fields.name: file_id
fields.description: Identifier for the video file which can be used to download or reuse the file

fields.name: file_unique_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the video file which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Video width as defined by the sender

fields.name: height
fields.description: Video height as defined by the sender

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Duration of the video in seconds as defined by the sender

fields.name: mime_type
fields.description: MIME type of the file as defined by the sender

fields.name: file_size
fields.description: File size in bytes. It can be bigger than 2^31 and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a signed 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this value.

LivePhoto.description: This object represents a live photo.

Location.name: Location

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude as defined by the sender

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude as defined by the sender

fields.name: horizontal_accuracy
fields.description: The radius of uncertainty for the location, measured in meters; 0-1500

fields.name: live_period
fields.description: Time relative to the message sending date, during which the location can be updated; in seconds. For active live locations only.

fields.name: heading
fields.description: The direction in which user is moving, in degrees; 1-360. For active live locations only.

fields.name: proximity_alert_radius

ReplyParameters.name: ReplyParameters

fields.name: message_id
fields.description: Identifier of the message that will be replied to in the current chat, or in the chat chat_id if it is specified. Required if ephemeral_message_id isn't specified.

fields.name: chat_id
fields.description: If the message to be replied to is from a different chat, unique identifier for the chat or username of the bot, supergroup, or channel in the format @username. Not supported for messages sent on behalf of a business account, messages from channel direct messages chats and ephemeral messages.

fields.name: ephemeral_message_id
fields.description: Identifier of the incoming ephemeral message that will be replied to in the current chat. A reply to an ephemeral message must itself be an ephemeral message. An ephemeral message may only be replied to within 15 seconds of being sent. Required if message_id isn't specified.

fields.name: allow_sending_without_reply
fields.description: Pass True if the message should be sent even if the specified message to be replied to is not found. Always False for replies in another chat or forum topic, and sent ephemeral messages. Always True for messages sent on behalf of a business account.

fields.name: quote
fields.description: Quoted part of the message to be replied to; 0-1024 characters after entities parsing. The quote must be an exact substring of the message to be replied to, including bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, spoiler, custom_emoji, and date_time entities. The message will fail to send if the quote isn't found in the original message. Ignored for ephemeral messages.

fields.name: quote_parse_mode
fields.description: Mode for parsing entities in the quote. See formatting options for more details.

fields.name: quote_entities
fields.description: A JSON-serialized list of special entities that appear in the quote. It can be specified instead of quote_parse_mode.

fields.name: quote_rich_texts
fields.description: A JSON-serialized list of quoted parts of the rich message to be replied to. Must contain one element for each quoted text of the message in the order of their appearance. Each of the following is a separate quoted text: the text of a paragraph, a heading, a preformatted block, a footer, or a mathematical expression; the text and the credit of a block quotation or a pull quotation; the summary of a details block; the caption and each cell of a table; the text and the credit of a caption of a media block, a collage, a slideshow, or a map. Texts of blocks nested in lists, block quotations, details, collages, and slideshows are separate quoted texts too. The first and the last elements can contain only a part of the corresponding text; all other elements must contain the whole text. Formatting of the quoted parts must be kept, and rich texts must be nested in the same way as in the message received from the server. Mathematical expressions must be quoted entirely. Buttons in RichBlockButtons, anchors and dividers can't be quoted. Up to 32 quoted texts with total length up to 1024 characters can be specified. Only plain text, RichTextBold, RichTextItalic, RichTextUnderline, RichTextStrikethrough, RichTextSpoiler, RichTextSubscript, RichTextSuperscript, RichTextDateTime, RichTextCustomEmoji, RichTextMathematicalExpression, and arrays of them are kept in the quote; other rich text types are replaced with their text. If non-empty, then quote, quote_parse_mode and quote_entities are ignored.

fields.name: quote_position
fields.description: Position of the quote in the original message in UTF-16 code units. For quotes from rich messages, it is the position in the text formed by joining plain texts of all quotable texts of the message, separated by line feeds.

fields.name: checklist_task_id
fields.description: Identifier of the specific checklist task to be replied to

fields.name: poll_option_id
fields.description: Persistent identifier of the specific poll option to be replied to

fields.name: update_id
fields.description: The update's unique identifier. Update identifiers start from a certain positive number and increase sequentially. This identifier becomes especially handy if you're using webhooks, since it allows you to ignore repeated updates or to restore the correct update sequence, should they get out of order. If there are no new updates for at least a week, then identifier of the next update will be chosen randomly instead of sequentially.

fields.name: message
fields.description: New incoming message of any kind - text, photo, sticker, etc.

fields.description: New version of a message that is known to the bot and was edited. This update may at times be triggered by changes to message fields that are either unavailable or not actively used by your bot.

fields.description: A reaction to a message was changed by a user. The bot must be an administrator in the chat and must explicitly specify "message_reaction" in the list of allowed_updates to receive these updates. The update isn't received for reactions set by bots.

fields.name: message_reaction_count
fields.description: Reactions to a message with anonymous reactions were changed. The bot must be an administrator in the chat and must explicitly specify "message_reaction_count" in the list of allowed_updates to receive these updates. The updates are grouped and can be sent with delay up to a few minutes.

fields.name: inline_query
fields.description: New incoming inline query

fields.name: chosen_inline_result
fields.description: The result of an inline query that was chosen by a user and sent to their chat partner. Please see our documentation on the feedback collecting for details on how to enable these updates for your bot.

fields.description: New incoming callback query

fields.description: The data. Be aware that a bad client can send arbitrary data in this field.

fields.name: last_synchronization_error_date

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the shared widget, which can be used to send the widget again using the method sendSharedWidget; omitted if the widget isn't shared

fields.name: width
fields.description: Width of the widget in logical pixels; omitted if the widget must occupy the whole width of the message bubble

fields.name: height
fields.description: Height of the widget in logical pixels; omitted if the height of the widget isn't fixed

fields.name: html
fields.description: HTML code of the widget

fields.name: public_data
